facts.label: Regras e rotina
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para conselhos: You should wear a cap. Use o present simple para rotina: The class starts at six. It lasts forty-five minutes.

facts.label: Conselho
facts.sub: Para dar conselhos, use should + verbo base: You should wear a cap. You should breathe slowly. Depois de should, não use to. A forma não muda com she ou it.

facts.label: Rotina
facts.sub: Para falar de rotina, use o present simple: The class starts at six. It lasts forty-five minutes. Com it, she e he, adicione s ao verbo.

After should, we use to + verb.
“The class starts at six” is correct.

After should, we use to + verb. → Falso (We use the base verb.)
